currentScopeReview.sourceMeasureNumbers: Editorially counted 30 bars in five six-bar systems; no printed bar numbers. First 18 bars are verse, final 12 are bracketed two-voice chorus.
currentScopeReview.voiceDecision: The verse is monophonic. Chorus lyrics align with the upper of two explicitly bracketed voice lines. Select that identified principal vocal part, not the highest note or an array-order heuristic. The lower chorus voice is omitted; no backing is inferred.
currentScopeReview.tempoDecision: 96 BPM is an editorial practice choice retained from the previous built-in, not a printed numeric source or recording tempo. The 0.9 suggestion remains unchanged and does not overwrite initial or saved actual browser speed.
currentScopeReview.difficultyDecision: medium is an editorial conditional practice suggestion, not a source grading or completed physical-playability finding.
currentScopeReview.registerConvention: Unmarked numbered degree 1 is read as Eb4; lower-dot 6 is C4 and upper-dot 1 is Eb5. A single -3-semitone transposition gives C4 tonic and A3–C5. No extra global octave change or local folds.
currentScopeReview.formDecision: Play all 30 printed bars once through the final double bar. The three verse lyric rows do not authorize repeat expansion. This retains the complete printed one-strophe tune and refrain, not every sung stanza or a complete recorded-song form.
occurrenceDecisions: m8–9: E4@14/3 spans the barline; E4@17/0.5 remains a new attack. m17–18: G4@32/3 ends before the quarter rest at 35. m29–30: A4@56/4 spans the final two bars as one attack.
m6 G4@10/1.5 and G4@11.5/0.5, m20 A4@38/1.5 and A4@39.5/0.5, and m26 G4@51/0.75 and G4@51.75/0.25 are separate attacks, not ties.
m12 preserves the upper-tonic C5 followed by B4 and A4 sixteenths; m24 lower-dot 6 becomes A3 at 46. Every later occurrence was read rather than copied from an earlier phrase.
Different-pitch arcs remain slurs. Breath marks at m13 and m21 add no quantified silence and shorten no note.
currentScopeReview.ornamentDecision: One unquantified grace degree 5 before m7 is deliberately omitted from metric single-note practice. No guessed duration, extra attack or stolen beat is introduced. This is a disclosed adaptation, not an ornament-complete literal engraving realization.
currentScopeReview.restScope: Four source rests in the selected principal vocal line: [0,0.5), [8,8.5), [35,36), [48,49). The last rest is also printed in the lower chorus voice. No backing is selected, so these are silent windows of this single-melody adaptation; they do not certify silence in other arrangements or stop natural decay.
currentScopeReview.endingDecision: Final A4 attacks at 56 and lasts four beats through m29–30 to the double bar at 60. Do not reattack at 58, clip the tie, invent an ending rest or turn notation duration into a PCM/effects-tail cutoff.
currentScopeReview.versionDecision: This deliberately selected textbook edition does not prove the unavailable Qupu version-three source or old encoding wrong. All 63 onset/duration pairs agree, while the first 54 old pitches through beat 50 are one octave higher and the last nine from 51 already agree; this is not a global octave-down operation on the old file.
currentScopeReview.supportDecision: No backing is added or borrowed. There is no existing source sibling for this id. The old melody fails the actual compatibility guard despite identical timings, title family and 96 BPM; synthetic old-backed candidates must be rejected by both provider paths.
currentScopeReview.sourcePixelReview: The compiler and independent reviewer each read the actual textbook pages before comparison; all 63 tuples, 30 bar spans, three ties and four rests agree. The implementation worker also viewed pages 41–42, the colophon and following unrelated page 43. These are independent readings of one edition, not independent source editions.
